Since that first trip, we’ve brought 2,500 nomads together in 80 cities to colive and cowork around the world, one month at a time.

Our work has sparked thousands of lifelong friendships, countless perspective-shifting conversations, hundreds of startup projects and career shifts, so many new romances, lots of weddings, a few babies, and an unimaginable amount of core memories.

What we do changes lives.

Not a little, but a lot and in every way you can think of.

If this excites you, keep reading to see if this might be the most perfect job ever created for you.

What is WiFi Tribe?

We believe that life wasn’t meant to be lived in just one place. That your best work can be done from anywhere. And, that everything is better when you have great people by your side.

We bring together great people from around the world to help them overcome the loneliness of solo travel, find true community wherever they go, and make their biggest travel dreams a reality, together.

We connect our members through:

40 coliving/coworking retreats in exciting destinations,

a Slack community where members share advice and support each other, and

an exclusive app that helps members meet in-person anywhere in the world, and plan their next big adventure together.

WiFi Tribe is THE vetted global community for remote professionals who seek growth and long-lasting travel connections.

YOUR Mission:

The Tribe needs a lot of tech and business operations to connect so many people around the world.

We’re looking for a Tech Lead & Business Ops to take charge of our technology stack and help us keep the day-to-day of the company operating smoothly.

You will be the centre-point for the tools that power our community. You’ll help scale our operations by enhancing our booking systems, integrating external services, and automating workflows. This role is perfect for a hands-on tech leader with a passion for building impactful systems and a knack for solving complex challenges.

Your work will directly shape the experience of thousands of members, empowering them to live, work, and explore the world together.

Who We Are (Our Culture)

  • We’re obsessed with this community. We have all chosen to join the team, first and foremost, because we love this community; a place where remarkable people from all over the world meet and shape their ideal lives together.
  • We’re a tight-knit team. We look out for one another, cheer each other on, and celebrate every win. We’re fully remote, and always bouncing around the world, but take every chance to meet up in person.
  • We’re as diverse as the United Nations. Our team of 13 represents 10 different nationalities! Many of us have become permanently nomadic global citizens, as we travel the world side-by-side with our members.
  • We’re small but mighty. Our small size is our strength. It helps us stay agile, creative, and united in the camaraderie of achieving our mission. We’re nifty, we’re inventive and we don’t give up.
  • We show courage. We don’t compromise when it comes to our values, our mission, or who we are. Every member of our team has the courage to stand up for what they believe in and challenge bad ideas. We know that doing the right thing always pays off in the end.
  • We care. We take full ownership of our work because we take pride in everything we do. We care about how we show up and who or what we’re becoming. And of course, we care about our teammates and our community members.
  • We’re explorers at heart. We’re curious and adaptable, which is why each of us chose to take on this crazy challenge of building a global community and a startup at the same time. Everyone on the team has lived, worked, and travelled with the Tribe for at least a month – some of us for years. Joining this team means embarking on the biggest adventure of your career.
  • We lead with humility. We don’t compete for titles or status; we’re driven by passion for our mission and love for our work. There is no space for big egos here. But, we take pride in our work and in becoming great at what we do.

Requirements

Who You Are (Traits)

We’re seeking a builder who is also a thinker—someone who thrives in a fast-paced, iterative environment and can bring a product-oriented mindset to the table.

  • You thrive under pressure and can juggle multiple priorities without breaking a sweat.
  • You’re a meticulous problem solver who never lets anything slip through the cracks. You analyse data and try to understand the root cause following the first-principle thinking methodology.
  • You’re strategic and organised and love creating systems that empower teams to do their best work.
  • You’re a self-starter who takes ownership of projects from start to finish and delivers results.
  • A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills in a remote-first environment.
  • You embrace rapid iteration and short-release cycles for customer-facing and internal tools.
  • You are pragmatic and balance the trade-offs between building in-house tools and integrating external services.
  • You are passionate about the user experience and product-driven, and you understand and deliver intuitive, user-friendly designs.

What You’ve Done (Qualifications)

  • Experience with payment integrations and CRM platforms to streamline workflows and optimise business processes.
  • Experience integrating external APIs and services: Proven ability to connect and manage third-party tools to enhance functionality and performance.
  • 2+ years of server administration and management: Proficient in maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimising server environments.
  • 2+ years of experience with database management: Strong knowledge of relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL.
  • Hands-on experience running custom web applications: Demonstrated ability to manage and maintain live applications, ensuring stability and performance.

Ideal Skills/Background (But Not Required)

  • 2+ years of experience with Docker or Kubernetes: Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with low code and automation tools: Familiarity with tools such as Zapier and experience in utilising such tools to build integrations or apps.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: General knowledge of web technologies to support collaboration with development teams.
  • Experience with web application development workflows: Preferably with exposure to Python, Django, and PostgreSQL environments.
  • Knowledge of SysOps/DevOps practices: Awareness of best practices for system operations and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with data analysis and business intelligence reporting: Experience in data analysis and using tools such as Tableau, Metabase or advanced spreadsheet formulae.
  • Experience with remote work or digital nomad culture: Comfortable working in distributed teams and understanding the nuances of remote collaboration.

Things You Might Do Here (Responsibilities)

Technical Ownership

  • Take full ownership of WiFi Tribe’s tech stack, ensuring reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Define and oversee the architecture and workflows for our booking platform—focused on design, not coding - ensuring seamless execution by the development team
  • Design, implement, and optimise integrations with third-party systems to enhance functionality.

Collaboration & Automation

  • Partner with operations, marketing, and other teams to identify areas for workflow automation and implement solutions.
  • Collaborate across departments to ensure technology aligns with business needs.

System Design & Problem-Solving

  • Plan and execute the development of a custom Property Management System (PMS) or evaluate and implement third-party solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure or application issues, keeping the team productive and systems running smoothly.
  • Manage technical projects from concept to completion, ensuring clear communication and timely delivery.

Benefits

  • A Culture of Connection: Be part of a team and community prioritising meaningful relationships.
  • Freedom to Explore: Work remotely from anywhere in the world while helping others do the same.
  • A Mission That Matters: Build tools for a community that transforms lives and inspires growth.
  • $1,500 - $2,500 monthly for part-time work, depending on experience and track record of success in similar roles.
  • Take on a key role in a growing start-up with a community described by its members as transformative and “life-changing” that’s built a cult-like following and is now one of the strongest brands in a rapidly growing market.
  • Opportunities to join Chapters: If you're okay with making some spontaneous travel plans, you can join any Chapter that still has spots left for free! Experience the most adventurous months of your life. Travel and work remotely alongside a group of talented but down-to-earth remote professionals.

  • Sponsored learning resources and conference opportunities.

C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Platform Connect team at Enode, you'll focus on improving the reliability, observability, and scalability of Enode's connectivity layer. This is the part of our API that aggregates integrations with EV chargers, vehicles, and OEM platforms into one cohesive and reliable product for our customers.

This is not an infrastructure or DevOps role. The Platform Connect team owns the product level platform that powers connectivity at Enode, maintaining and extending the layer that links our users to energy devices through consistent, high quality integrations.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company.

As an open source platform, we have teams that work at every level of the software stack - from the kernel up through server and desktop applications, all the way to the web. We are adding roles with this focus in every engineering team in the company, to act as drivers of performance engineering skills, tools, culture and insights to our entire product range. We have also created a central performance engineering team, where we will drive shared tools, dashboarding capabilities, measurement frameworks, analytical capabilities and skills. We call this career focus 'percorr' because we have found that the same deep insights that enable sophisticated performance measurement and design also enable teams to improve their harnesses and frameworks for correctness. Understanding not only the application, but the runtime, the compiler, and the system, all the way down to the CPU, gives an engineer the ability to think creatively and with insight about the right things to measure, and the right ways to verify correctness. We have found that performance engineers will often improve the deepest and trickiest areas of our test harnesses, and unblock their teams to test and measure previously 'dark' aspects of their work.

We also have teams that work with every major silicon vendor and cloud, with a particular emphasis on performance optimisation of the entire stack for that architecture, CPU family or hypervisor. Our goal is to ensure that Ubuntu users can select whatever platform they want for their workloads and know they have access to the very best performance and efficiency across the entire stack from kernel to codec.

If they wish, we will enable performance and correctness engineers to move between products every two years, so that they have the opportunity to raise the bar for performance in an array of products over time, and also that teams have the benefit of fresh eyes on their processes, thinking, harnesses, dashboards and code. Our performance and correctness leads are expected to be truly exceptional individuals, and also leaders who are confident setting expectations of change, sharing insights and skills, running initiatives and programs. There is no way to move a meaningful codebase without also moving the people behind it.

This is a career path for perfectionists and precision artists. Whether you have a particular language focus - C, C++, Rust, Golang, Python, Java, Flutter-Dart or others - or a particular love of the kernel or hardware or CPU instruction set, whether you see yourself as driving perceived user experience through performance or optimising the efficiency of data centers to reduce carbon footprint, this process is the best way to find a role at Canonical that speaks to your precision, rigour, insight and drive.

Location: We have teams in every time zone, and can accommodate applications from almost any country.

  • Low-level CPU insights and assembly language - understanding cache, registers, vectorization, memory
  • Kernel performance insights - scheduling, context switching, hardware acceleration
  • Distributed systems performance insights - tracing, debugging
  • Compiler level performance insights - profile guided optimization, inlining, assembler
  • Runtime performance insights - Golang, Python, JVM, NodeJS
  • Database performance evaluation - plans, indexing, data modelling, tracing, monitoring
  • Web browser performance insights - JS, web frameworks, tracing, CSS
  • Performance measurement tooling - profiling, eBPF, D-Trace, flamegraphs
  • Benchmarks and performance measurement tools - Phoronix Test Suite, others
  • Test harnesses and capabilities in C, C++, Rust, Python, Golang, NodeJS, JavaScript

The role entails

  • Drive software performance and correctness in a specific project
  • Collaborate with colleagues and community around the globe
  • Work on shared tools and infrastructure for performance measurement, analysis and reporting
  • Teach, train and develop skills in your team for performance culture and design
  • Strengthen test capabilities, harnesses and pipelines
  • Analyze systems and code to understand performance and scalability
  • Solve problems directly or through influence, leadership and skills development
  • Review code and technical designs

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or Physics
  • Demonstrable personal initiatives to measure and improve performance, efficiency and correctness in code
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

À propos de l’équipe Tech chez Ornikar ✨

Nous développons les produits technologiques qui révolutionnent l'enseignement du code de la route et de la conduite. Notre équipe tech réunit une cinquantaine d'ingénieur·es (front, back, QA, SRE) répartis en squads autonomes.

Côté frontend, le périmètre couvre l'ensemble de nos interfaces utilisateur : nos applications mobiles en React Native (Expo, bare workflow), app B2B enseignants et app B2C candidats, ainsi que nos interfaces web en React. TypeScript est utilisé sur la majorité de nos projets.

  • Design system conçu par nos équipes, langage commun avec les designers

  • Qualité et tests : tests e2e, validation CI, tests de non-régression graphique

  • Déploiement continu : plus de 20 déploiements par jour en moyenne

  • Monitoring : Datadog pour les performances applicatives, les logs et l'infra

    • Nous recherchons trois Frontend Engineer🚨

    Nous recrutons trois Frontend Engineers pour renforcer nos squads Education : Experience, Purchase Marketplace et Enablement Engineering.

    Avant d'aller plus loin, voici rapidement nos différentes squads pour lesquelles nous recrutons.

    🎓 Squad Experience

    La squad Experience construit le parcours d'apprentissage de nos élèves, du premier test de code jusqu'au passage du permis, ainsi que les outils pédagogiques de nos enseignants partenaires. L'enjeu : un parcours limpide pour tous nos candidats, du suivi des étapes d'apprentissage au suivi pédagogique, en passant par les démarches administratives.

    C'est aussi la squad qui réinvente l'apprentissage du code de la route sur mobile et sur le web, et qui explore l'intégration de l'IA pour personnaliser et faciliter le parcours d'obtention du permis. Le tout en construisant un produit scalable, pour la France et potentiellement pour l'international.

    💳 Squad Purchase

    La squad Purchase est au cœur du parcours d'achat d'Ornikar : c'est par ses services que passe chaque transaction de nos élèves, qu'il s'agisse de l'apprentissage du Code de la Route ou de la réservation d'heures de conduite auprès d'enseignants diplômés d'État.

    C'est un domaine exigeant et très concret. Une commande qui n'aboutit pas, un paiement encaissé sans contrepartie ou un remboursement qui échoue a un impact immédiat côté élève, côté business et côté support. La squad porte donc la fiabilité et la lisibilité du parcours de bout en bout, de l'onboarding à l'encaissement.

    🗓️ Squad Marketplace

    Chaque mois, plus de 30 000 élèves réservent plus de 150 000 heures de conduite avec nos plus de 2 000 enseignants indépendants, disponibles partout en France de 6h à 23h, 7 jours sur 7.

    L'ambition de la squad est de construire la meilleure expérience de réservation que vous ayez connue, et de faciliter le quotidien de milliers d'enseignants indépendants qui utilisent notre produit chaque jour.

    ⚙️ Squad Engineering Enablement

    Engineering Enablement est une squad tech for tech : ses utilisateurs sont les ingénieurs d'Ornikar, et son sujet est leur capacité à concevoir, tester et livrer vite et sereinement. Chaque amélioration livrée profite à toutes les squads.

    Côté frontend, le périmètre est concret : le management technique du design system et les sujets front transverses, la chaîne de build et de release sur les stores, les environnements de développement, l'outillage de test qui tient nos 20 déploiements quotidiens, et l'outillage AI de l'équipe tech.

    Vos missions, quelle que soit la squad 🎯

  • Concevoir et livrer des fonctionnalités à impact : en tant que Feature Owner, vous pilotez le cycle complet, du cadrage du problème utilisateur avec le PM et le designer, jusqu'au suivi post-déploiement et la mesure des résultats.

  • Élever la qualité frontend de la squad : vous contribuez à la définition des bonnes pratiques avec la Core Team front et vous en êtes le garant au quotidien (code reviews, standards, outillage).

  • Maintenir et faire évoluer la stack : performance, dette technique, montées de version, et contribution aux Working Groups transverses.

  • Animer la vie d'équipe : daily, sprint review, démos, etc. Vous êtes moteur dans les rituels et le partage de connaissance.

  • Décupler votre impact : grâce à l'IA, vous cherchez constamment à accélérer votre façon de travailler, et avez déjà expérimenté des use cases concrets avec un impact réel sur votre efficacité.

    • Le processus de recrutement 📞

  • Premier échange : un premier entretien avec un membre de notre équipe Talent Acquisition afin de mieux comprendre votre parcours, vos motivations, et vous présenter Ornikar et le poste.

  • Entretien métier : une discussion approfondie sur le poste, vos expériences et les enjeux de l’équipe avec un de nos Engineering Manager.

  • Deux tests techniques en live : deux exercices concrets pour vous projeter dans le quotidien du poste.

  • Rencontre avec l’équipe : un moment d’échange pour découvrir nos valeurs, nos méthodes de travail avec notre Antoine, VP Engineering & Joris, notre CTO.

Du baust Agenten für Aufgaben, die heute Handarbeit sind. Interviewnotizen zu Kandidatendossiers. Kundebriefings zu Mandatsakten. Prüfläufe, die melden, wenn eine Tabelle still aufgehört hat zu rechnen. Terminvorschläge, Nachfassen, Berichte.

Du entwickelst die Textqualität weiter. Die Ansprachetexte an Kandidaten klingen noch nach Maschine. Woran das liegt, ist analysiert und dokumentiert. Es umzusetzen ist offen, und es ist die Arbeit mit dem größten Hebel.

Du schließt Lücken im Bestand. Echte Fahrzeiten statt geschätzter. Datenprüfungen vor dem Import. Ein Abnahme-Test, der vor jeder Freigabe läuft.

Und du prüfst, was du gebaut hast. In diesem System sind Fehler unsichtbar: eine Spalte hat fünf Wochen nichts gerechnet, während die Oberfläche „100 Prozent fertig" anzeigte. Wer hier baut, ohne hinterher das Verhalten zu prüfen, richtet mehr Schaden an als Nutzen. Das ist die eine Regel, die nicht verhandelbar ist.

Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer. Keine Ebene dazwischen, keine Abstimmungsrunden.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Du hast schon etwas gebaut, das funktioniert hat. Ein Skript, ein Automatisierungs-Workflow, ein Werkzeug mit einer KI dahinter, irgendetwas, das ein Problem gelöst hat, das nicht deins war. Zeig es uns, das zählt mehr als jede Note.

Zusammen mit Claude & Co kommst du mit JSON und einer REST-Schnittstelle klar und schreibst kleine Skripte, in JavaScript oder Python. Du schreibst sauberes Deutsch und merkst, wenn ein Satz nach Maschine klingt. Du hast die Angewohnheit, nach einer Änderung nachzusehen, ob sie wirklich umgesetzt wurde, statt der Erfolgsmeldung zu glauben.

Welches Fach du studierst, ist zweitrangig. Immobilien- oder Recruiting-Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht. Sie sind hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

Was du davon hast

  • Du baust für einen echten Betrieb, nicht für eine Übungsaufgabe. Was du baust, läuft am nächsten Tag gegen echte Kandidaten und echte Kunden.
  • Du arbeitest mit dem aktuellen Werkzeugkasten: Claude, Clay, n8n, Lemlist, Recruiterflow, eigene HTML-Werkzeuge. Nichts davon ist Spielzeug, alles davon ist im Einsatz.
  • Du siehst die ganze Kette, von der Suche über die Bewertung bis zur Platzierung. Die meisten Praktika zeigen dir einen Ausschnitt.
  • Du bekommst ein Zeugnis mit Zahlen darin, nicht mit Aufgabenlisten. Was du gebaut hast, was es eingespart hat, was du gefunden hast.

Wie es weitergeht

Melde dich über diese Anzeige. Erzähle von dir und wann dein Praktikum starten muss, wie lange es geht, und ein Link oder Screenshot von etwas, das du gebaut hast. Zwei Sätze dazu, was daran schwierig war.

Wir antworten innerhalb von drei Werktagen.

Le client est un acteur majeur du secteur Luxe & Cosmétique.

Tech Lead Agentic Systems - Beauty

Séniorité : 12 ans d'expérience minimum dont 3 ans sur des systèmes LLM en production et 5 ans de leadership technique ·

Langues : anglais courant (langue de travail), français apprécié

Contexte

Trois écosystèmes existent déjà et doivent converger. Pegasus, la plateforme de données produit du Groupe (GCP, BigQuery, dbt, knowledge graph), expose 100 % des attributs produit par API et dispose d'un agent produit en prototype (serveur MCP, routage d'intention, démonstration fonctionnelle sur tous les GTIN). Orion, la plateforme interne de déploiement d'expériences par marque et par pays, développe sa capacité MCP pour servir des agents et des MCP Apps à ChatGPT et aux retailers. Le service consommateurs tourne sur Salesforce Agentforce (agent WISMO en production depuis avril 2026) et sera le premier consommateur de l'agent produit. Modiface, la filiale computer vision du Groupe, fournit l'essayage virtuel et les diagnostics, déjà exposés dans ChatGPT et dans l'application du retailer Watsons (Malaisie).

La phase en cours (octobre à décembre 2026) doit livrer trois choses : la mise en production de l'agent produit sous conformité Groupe (Trustworthy AI, pentest et red-team, Comité Scientifique) et sa consommation par l'agent Care ; l'extraction des premiers agents réutilisables et leur portage sur Orion ; le cadrage de l'architecture cible présenté en Design Authority en janvier 2027, qui conditionne le financement de la montée en charge 2027.

Le rôle

Vous êtes l'unique tech lead de la squad Beauty Conversations — la personne la plus capée techniquement de l'équipe. La squad compte un program lead (pilotage, parties prenantes, budget) et neuf ingénieurs en montée en charge, embarqués au quotidien avec les équipes produit et engineering O+O, Modiface, le Care, la core team Orion, le bureau du CTO et l'Enterprise Architecture. Vous êtes le relais direct du CTO et du Head of Engineering auprès de l'équipe qui implémente : vous tenez les rituels techniques, validez les pull requests, portez les designs et faites respecter les standards. Vous portez la livraison technique de la phase et co-écrivez l'architecture cible. L'architecture des plateformes existantes (Pegasus, Orion) reste sous l'autorité de leurs référents groupe ; vous construisez avec eux, pas par-dessus.

Vous êtes un doer. Vous codez, vous relisez, vous tranchez. Vous êtes capable, dans la même journée, de refuser une PR, de tenir une position d'interface face à un éditeur et de préparer un dossier de Design Authority.

Le critère de succès de la phase est explicite : obtenir en janvier 2027 le feu vert des sponsors pour démarrer la montée en charge, sur la base de trois cas d'usage en production et d'un dossier d'architecture accepté.

Responsabilités

Livrer l'agent produit Pegasus en production : serveur MCP, routage d'intention et sélection d'outils, harnais d'évaluation (jeu de questions de référence par intention, F1 par outil, porte de non-régression en CI), observabilité par tour de conversation, contrat de consommation validé par l'équipe Care en pré-production, runbook et SLO.

Préparer et défendre les dossiers de conformité Groupe avec les ingénieurs IA : fiche Trustworthy AI, pack de préparation au pentest et au red-team (modèle de menace, injection de prompt, exfiltration par les outils), dossier d'évidence pour le Comité Scientifique (sources par claim, questions de santé et contre-indications). Le groupe tient les gates ; vous les préparez, les défendez et remédiez.

Concevoir l'interopérabilité entre plateformes : exposition des sous-agents Agentforce (statut de commande, transfert à un humain) via contrats MCP et/ou A2A versionnés, consommés depuis un agent Google ADK, sans forker les templates Care en production ; registre d'agents et documentation d'intégration.

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

Ça tombe bien. On a un blog technique qui est là pour ça. Pareil pour la création de ton talk. Tu veux te faire la main sur une techno inconnue ou te perfectionner ? Nos projets internes sont là pour ça.

Finto is on a mission to reinvent how enterprises run their finance operations. Starting with AI-powered automation for accounts payable, we eliminate manual invoice handling, supplier chasing, 3-Way-Matching and ERP data entry. Backed by Y Combinator, we're building the future of enterprise accounting.

Our mission is to free the world's finance teams from repetitive, low-value tasks so they can focus on impactful work. That starts with building a place where everyone can do their best work. Whether you're building on our platform, partnering with our customers, or shaping our story: We just make things finance teams want.

About the role

We are hiring an Entrepreneur in Residence to work directly with our CTO. You will take ownership of important, loosely defined problems and deliver results.

Your initial focus will be customer integrations and solution engineering. You will lead strategic customer initiatives, translate recurring needs into product direction, and help reduce the time our CTO spends on solution scoping. As you prove ownership, your scope can expand into product discovery, internal engineering, or AI adoption.

This is a hands-on role. You will build, investigate, make decisions, and follow through. It is not a support or project-management position.

What you’ll do

Lead strategic customer initiatives

Own important customer engagements from discovery through delivery. Join technical conversations, clarify requirements, and act as the CTO’s delegate where agreed. Turn recurring customer needs into clear input for the product roadmap.

Drive product and technical discovery

Turn open questions into specifications and prototypes. Evaluate whether we should build, buy, or integrate. Research technical options and recommend a clear course of action.

Improve how our engineers work

Remove friction from onboarding, permissions, tooling, and internal infrastructure. Build secure, self-service workflows that help engineers work effectively.

Lead practical AI adoption

Test new AI tools and workflows across Finto. Measure whether they improve speed or quality, train the team on useful applications, and introduce appropriate guardrails.

Your priorities will change as the company changes. One week you may scope an ERP integration. The next, you may prototype a product idea or improve an internal workflow.

What we’re looking for

  • You have built something from scratch and taken responsibility for the outcome.

  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity without waiting for detailed instructions.

  • You can understand software architecture, build prototypes, and work with modern AI and LLM tools.

  • You are familiar with Node.js, TypeScript, and integration-heavy systems.

  • You have worked at startup speed, whether as a founder, early engineer, forward-deployed engineer, or in a Founder’s Office or Chief of Staff role.

  • You communicate clearly in German and English.

  • You want to take on more responsibility as you grow.

Experience with ERP integrations, fintech, developer tooling, or customer-facing technical work is helpful but not required.

Working at Finto

  • Work with the founders on problems that directly affect customers and the company.

  • Take ownership early. Your scope will grow with the results you deliver.

  • Join our in-office team in Munich five days per week.

  • Receive 25 vacation days and two company-wide recharge days.

  • Build relationships through Finto’s Y Combinator and San Francisco network.

Interview process

  1. Introductory call: 20 minutes with our CEO

  2. Technical call: 30 minutes with our CTO

  3. Working session: 90-minute technical challenge

  4. Culture interview with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Compensation: €60K – €80K • Offers Equity

About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow it into a team.

  • Real enterprise SAP landscapes from week one, not a sandbox.

  • 25 vacation days + 2 fixed "company recharge days."

  • A vibrant in-office culture (5 days/week) in a modern office.

Interview Process

  1. Intro - 20 mins with our CEO

  2. Technical Get to Know - 30 mins with our CTO

  3. Challenge - 60 mins architecture & design challenge on a real SAP landscape

  4. Culture call with our CPO

  5. Meet the team

  6. Offer

Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte
  • Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice
  • Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur
  • Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt

Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions

  • Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

Wofür wir stehen:

“We drive digital transformation end-to-end - from strategy to execution. Creating measurable progress and real impact for our clients.”
 
Stillstand? Nicht mit uns. Wir glauben: Alles ist BETA und genau darin liegt die Chance für Fortschritt. Darum hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, wagen Neues und gestalten die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden aktiv mit.
Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche hat sich in zwei Jahren mehr verändert als in den zehn davor. Unsere Kunden, B2B Hidden Champions aus Manufacturing, Industrial Goods und Wholesale, 300 Mio. bis 5 Mrd. EUR Umsatz, merken das gerade: organischer Traffic bricht ein, obwohl die Rankings stabil sind. Recherchen beginnen immer häufiger auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode statt ausschließlich auf der Suchergebnisseite. Du machst diese Marken in klassischer Suche und in generativen Systemen sichtbar. Der Hebel dafür ist Content: Sichtbarkeit entsteht heute über Inhalte, die Suchintention treffen und zitierfähig sind, nicht über Keyword-Dichte. Du gibst die inhaltliche Richtung vor und sorgst dafür, dass die Sichtbarkeit belegbar ist, nicht behauptet.

  • Strategie über die gesamte Suchlandschaft: Du entwickelst Search- und Content-Strategien, die klassisches SEO und GEO/AI Search zusammenführen, statt sie als zwei Projekte zu behandeln. Du priorisierst nach Impact, nicht nach Vollständigkeit.
  • Technisches SEO in der Tiefe: Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, JS-Rendering, Logfile-Analyse, internes Verlinkungs- und Informationsdesign. Du begleitest Relaunches und Migrationen so, dass danach nicht die Sichtbarkeit fehlt.
  • Content-Strategie und Entitätsarchitektur: Du entwickelst Themen-, Content- und Entitätsarchitekturen entlang der B2B Buying Journey von Awareness-Content für die frühe Recherche bis zu Deep-Content, aus dem LLMs zitieren. Du entscheidest, welche Themen besetzt werden, welche Formate es braucht und was bestehender Content leisten muss.
  • Content steuern, nicht schreiben: Du briefst unser Content-Team und die Fachexpert:innen unserer Kunden, reviewst gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und entscheidest, was publiziert wird. Du baust Content-Audits, findest Kannibalisierung und Substanzlücken und leitest daraus einen Redaktionsplan ab, der auch in sechs Monaten noch trägt. Die Texte schreiben andere. Die Richtung gibst du.
  • AI Visibility aufbauen: Du arbeitest an konsistenter Entitätsdarstellung (strukturierte Daten, sameAs, Wikidata, Branchenverzeichnisse), an zitierfähigen Inhalten und an Präsenz in den Quellen, aus denen LLMs tatsächlich zitieren.
  • AI Visibility messbar machen: Prompt-Set-basierter Share of Voice über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode – inklusive Auswertung von GPTBot-, OAI-SearchBot- und PerplexityBot-Zugriffen in den Logfiles. Referral-Traffic aus generativen Quellen trennst du so weit, wie die Datenlage es zulässt, und dokumentierst die Grenzen der Messung offen.
  • Audits mit Konsequenz: Du führst SEO- und GEO-Audits durch, analysierst Wettbewerb und Suchintentionen und leitest daraus priorisierte Maßnahmen ab, die jemand am Montag anfangen kann.
  • Verantwortung im Retainer: Du steuerst mehrere Kundenaccounts parallel, arbeitest in vereinbarten Stundenbudgets, führst die monatlichen Reporting-Calls und Quarterly Reviews und flaggst Scope-Themen früh statt spät.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du präsentierst auf Management-Level, bist Sparringspartner:in für Marketing- und Digital-Verantwortliche und sagst auch die unbequeme Wahrheit, wenn die Lieblings-KPI nichts über das Geschäft aussagt.
  • Neugeschäft mitgestalten: Du unterstützt bei Pitches und Angeboten, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein und bringst dein Fachthema in Kundengespräche ein, bevor das Projekt startet.
  • AI-native im eigenen Handwerk: Du nutzt LLMs und Automatisierung für Analyse, Content-Optimierung und Reporting – und weißt, wo AI-Output eine fachliche Prüfung braucht.
  • Wissen weitergeben: Du coachst Kolleg:innen und Kunden, arbeitest eng mit Content, Performance und mit deinem Analytics-Pendant zusammen und dokumentierst so, dass Setups auch nach einer Übergabe noch tragen.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Erfahrung mit Substanz: Mindestens 5 Jahre in SEO – mit echter Projektverantwortung, nicht nur Zuliefern. Du hast Setups gebaut, die noch tragen, nachdem du das Projekt abgegeben hast.
  • Technisches SEO ist dein Zuhause: Du kannst ein Setup mit fünfstelliger URL-Zahl auditieren und die Findings priorisieren. Search Console inkl. API ist dein Tagestool, dazu Screaming Frog, Logfiles und eine der gängigen Suites (Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs).
  • Content-Kompetenz auf Steuerungsebene: Du hast Content-Strategien für erklärungsbedürftige B2B-Themen verantwortet, inklusive Themenarchitektur, Redaktionsplanung und Qualitätssicherung. Du schreibst Briefings, die ein Redakteur versteht, reviewst Texte gegen Suchintention und Zitierfähigkeit und erkennst, wann ein Text fachlich zu dünn ist, um in generativen Antworten zu bestehen. Selbst schreiben musst du nicht.
  • GEO-Erfahrung oder GEO-Neugier: Du hast schon an AI-Sichtbarkeit gearbeitet – oder du hast dich so ernsthaft eingelesen und ausprobiert, dass du eine fundierte Meinung dazu hast. Zum Beispiel dazu, ob llms.txt überschätzt ist. Wir erwarten keine fünf Jahre Erfahrung in einer Disziplin, die es seit zwei Jahren gibt.
  • Datenkompetenz, ohne Analytics-Rolle: Du liest GA4 und Search Console sicher, kannst mit BigQuery-Exports arbeiten und formulierst, welche Messung du brauchst. Bauen muss sie ein anderer – aber du weißt, was du bestellst.
  • B2B-Verständnis: Du weißt, dass eine 9-monatige Buying Journey mit sechs Beteiligten andere Antworten braucht als ein D2C-Shop. Projekterfahrung in Manufacturing, Industrial Goods, Maschinenbau oder Wholesale ist ein Plus.
  • Analytisches Denken mit Mut zur Aussage: Du erkennst Muster und traust dich, daraus eine klare Empfehlung abzuleiten – auch wenn sie nicht die bequeme ist.
  • Kommunikation: Du erklärst einer Geschäftsführung, warum eine Entitätsstruktur eine Investition wert ist. Souverän, ohne zu vereinfachen.
  • Hands-on und geduldig mit Kundenrealität: TYPO3-Installationen von 2014, eine IT, die sechs Wochen für ein Deployment braucht, ein CMS ohne Zugriff auf die Meta-Ebene. Du kennst das und arbeitest trotzdem an Ergebnissen. Bei Unklarheiten holst du dir gezielt den nötigen Input aus dem Team und arbeitest anschließend eigenständig und zuverlässig weiter.
  • Excel beherrschst du im Schlaf
  • Sprachen: Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und sicher in Englisch.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin


Warum wir?

Wir glauben: Wer viel gibt, soll auch viel zurückbekommen. Deshalb erwarten dich bei uns Benefits, die über „Extras“ hinausgehen. Sie geben dir Freiheit, Flexibilität und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, und machen deinen Arbeitsalltag einfach besser.

Aujourd’hui basé sur des applications client lourd Windows et des tableaux de bord Power BI, cet écosystème fait l’objet d’une refonte intégrale vers une architecture Web moderne, centralisée, sécurisée et préparée pour l’IA.

Vous intégrerez le projet dès son lancement en novembre 2026 pour concevoir, développer et déployer les modules clés de la plateforme :

  1. Refonte de la base de données centrale & API REST :

    • Réécriture complète du référentiel de prix centralisé sous forme d’application Web et d’API REST consommée par tout l’écosystème.

    • Gestion avancée des référentiels (versionning, publication, archivage) et moteur de recherche multicritère / plein texte.

  2. Migration Web de l’application d’estimation financière :

    • Migration du cœur métier du client lourd vers une interface Web Angular fluide et moderne.

    • Développement des fonctionnalités de structuration de projets, calculs complexes, gestion de scénarios, exports (Word, PDF) et tableaux de bord KPI.

  3. Création du Dashboard Métier Native Web (Remplacement Power BI) :

    • Refonte d’un outil de suivi des risques et d’exposition financière en une application native intégrée à l’écosystème.

    • Restitution de données en quasi-temps réel, vues portefeuille, cartographies des risques et système d’alertes.

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account.   • Own incidents end-to-end — investigate, resolve, and drive post-mortems to improve system reliability.

Qui sommes nous ?

 

Chez MARGO, nos consultants travaillent sur ce qui compte vraiment : des projets complexes qui allient challenge intellectuel et impact business réel. C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance, de l’industrie et de la tech dans la conception et le développement de solutions logicielles à haute performance : architectures distribuées, plateformes cloud, systèmes temps réel et applications critiques à grande échelle.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre la practice Software Engineering ?

 

Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe encadrée par Ludovic Vienot de Vaublanc, Practice Manager chez MARGO. Travailler à ses côtés, c’est bénéficier d'une parfaite connaissance de l’entreprise, être accompagné de près dans votre évolution et contribuer à des projets IT exigeants et à fort impact pour nos clients.

 

Vos missions

 

Vous rejoindrez une équipe nouvellement créée chez un leader de l'énergie, dont la mission est de concevoir une plateforme de trading algorithmique dédiée au stockage d'énergie par batteries. Ce projet stratégique permet de stabiliser le réseau électrique en injectant de l'énergie lors des pics de consommation.

En tant que développeur C#, vous participerez à la construction d'une solution robuste, scalable et haute performance capable de piloter des actifs en Europe et aux États-Unis.

 

Vos responsabilités incluent :

 

- Développement du moteur de Trading : Concevoir les briques logicielles permettant l'algo-trading sur les marchés Intraday.

- Optimisation d’Assets : Implémenter et faire tourner des modèles d'optimisation complexes (prenant en compte la météo, les prix de marché et les profils de consommation).

- Plateforme de Backtesting : Développer un environnement sécurisé et performant permettant aux traders de tester et valider leurs stratégies algorithmiques.

- Scalabilité & Évolutivité : Participer à l'architecture d'une solution initialement centrée sur les batteries, mais destinée à intégrer à terme l'ensemble du parc renouvelable (éolien, hydraulique, thermique).

 

Challenges techniques : Haute performance, calcul distribué, robustesse des systèmes critiques (trading temps réel), scalabilité internationale.

Environnement fonctionnel : Marchés de l'énergie, trading algorithmique, gestion de la flexibilité électrique, Green Tech.

Stack technique : C# (.NET Core), Architecture orientée services, Cloud, Algorithmes d'optimisation.

 

Profil recherché :

 

Nous cherchons un Software Engineer C#, motivé par les défis techniques de la transition énergétique et l'univers des marchés financiers.

 

- Formation : Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur ou université).

- Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de l'écosystème C# / .NET, avec une attention particulière portée à la performance du code et aux architectures scalables.

- Esprit d'Innovation : Vous aimez partir d'une page blanche et participer à la création de nouveaux outils dans un contexte "from scratch".

- Expérience : Une expérience en finance de marché (Front-Office, trading) ou dans le secteur de l'énergie est un vrai plus.

- Soft Skills : Autonomie, curiosité pour les problématiques métiers complexes et capacité à collaborer avec des équipes de traders et d'analystes.

 

Ce que nous offrons :

 

- Des missions ambitieuses et variées, toujours sélectionnées pour leur valeur ajoutée.

- Un accompagnement de proximité par des experts reconnus.

- Une communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, avec workshops, conférences et échanges réguliers.

- Une culture d’exigence technique, de partage des connaissances et de développement continu.

 

La suite ?

1) Premier entretien : Échangez avec un recruteur et un business developer.

2) Entretien Technique : Montrez vos compétences et recevez un retour d'expérience.

3) Entretien de Motivation : Rencontrez Paul Blois, votre futur practice manager.

 

ENGAGEMENT POUR L'INCLUSION MARGO s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité.

What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system

What we are building

At ecoplanet, we're redefining energy for tomorrow. Our mission: turn energy management into the competitive edge every European business relies on to win its market. We're building the operating system for the energy transition — cutting energy costs, improving efficiency, and streamlining operations. Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.


Why This Role Matters

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Meter data integration. Connect industrial hardware and utility data streams into real-time dashboards. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is bringing data into a consistent structure across all sites
  • Anomalies and insights. This is where data science comes in. Find the things in the data a customer would want to know about — a meter drifting, a machine left running overnight, consumption that does not fit the pattern — and turn them into something they can act on
  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

  • Hands-on data science experience. You do not need a research background.   • Solid with Python and SQL and cloud data infrastructure. You have designed and run pipelines, APIs and workflows in production

  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings

  • You think end to end before you go deep.
